text: Election of the Vice Chair of the Planning and Housing Committee under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix A-2, for a term of office starting January 19, 2021 and ending November 14, 2022.

The Planning and Housing Committee: 1. Elected Councillor Paula Fletcher as Vice Chair of the Planning and Housing Committee for a term of office starting January 19, 2021 and ending November 14, 2022.
